title: Pre-registered rule baseline: does head-only COISC adaptation do more than a first-move direction rule on the R0-reversed pairs?
author_approval: Author approved option B on 2026-11-12 (add a first-move direction-rule baseline R0_GUARD to the six R0-reversed pairs of the closed-loop confirmation study).
question: A reviewer can ask why a trained penalty is needed if a one-line rule that blocks a reversed first move would do. This study adds that rule as a baseline arm and compares it with COISC on the pairs where the rule can act.
what_is_already_known_before_any_run: The six R0-reversed pairs (20261109,S12), (20261118,S10), (20261124,S10), (20261132,S04), (20261135,S04), (20261137,S12) and all R0/COISC/L0 closed-loop runs on them over 24 plants (CLOSEDLOOP_PROTOCOL sha c41c0783..., verdict PARTIAL_H2_ONLY).

A post-hoc trajectory analysis (not prespecified; timc_coisc/posthoc_tg.py) already computed the reversal fraction (FAR_BAND_C = 2 C) of R0/L0/COISC on these pairs: R0 0.167, 0.156, 0.327, 0.111, 0.071, 0.154; L0 0.135, 0.175, 0.308, 0.167, 0.033, 0.176; COISC 0.299, 0.105, 0.011, 0.007, 0.002, 0.185 (pair order as above). COISC is higher than R0 on two pairs.
In the earlier onset-aligned study (seeds 1-13, 4 R0-wrong pairs) R0_GUARD was close to R0 (R0 - R0_GUARD +0.016 C) and COISC_onset - R0_GUARD was -1.90 C, CI [-3.10; -0.59].
No R0_GUARD run of any of the 40 new seeds exists; its outcomes below are unseen.

arm.R0_GUARD: the R0 checkpoint of the same seed inside the unchanged MPC; at the first update only, if the MPC command moves strictly away from 37 C (sign of 37 - initial T_p), the previous command is held instead (onset_mil.guard_decision, unchanged, unit-tested). All later updates are the plain R0 MPC.
arm.information_note: The rule uses the sign of 37 - T_p at the start, i.e. one measurement of the unmeasured target. It is therefore an optimistic baseline that has information COISC does not use.

bench.runner: timc_coisc/onset_mil.run_one, unchanged (60 updates, 37 C reference, frozen MPCConfig, no T_p feedback to the controller)
bench.tasks: R0_GUARD x 6 R0-reversed pairs x 24 primary plants = 144 new runs; R0/COISC/L0 runs on the same cells (432) are reused from <outputs>/closedloop/study and hash-bound
bench.metric_tracking: MAE_track (deg C) of plant T_p against 37 C over the 60 updates (analyze_formal_control_v3.trace_metrics via onset_analyze_am1.metric_row, unchanged)
bench.metric_reversal: among updates whose preceding plant T_p is more than 2 C from 37 C, the fraction at which the applied command moves away from 37 C; counts pooled per plant family, then family-equal
bench.unit: pair; family-equal mean over the 24 plants (4 families)

hypotheses.G_H1_primary: COISC tracks better than the rule: effect = MAE[COISC] - MAE[R0_GUARD]; supported iff all 6 pairs are evaluable and the 95% percentile bootstrap CI upper bound (20,000 draws over pairs, seed 20261112) is < 0.
hypotheses.G_H2_primary: COISC makes fewer reversed moves over the whole trajectory than the rule: effect = reversal fraction[COISC] - reversal fraction[R0_GUARD]; same CI rule.
hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED iff both; otherwise PARTIAL_H1_ONLY, PARTIAL_H2_ONLY or NOT_SUPPORTED. Reported whatever it is.
hypotheses.power_note: Six pairs give little power. G_H2 is partly anticipated by the known COISC values, but the R0_GUARD values are unseen and differ from R0 after the first update because the trajectory changes. A NOT_SUPPORTED verdict will be reported as such.

secondary_descriptive: R0_GUARD - R0 and L0 - R0_GUARD for both metrics, point, CI, per-pair values, pairs lower
reversal fraction after the first update (steps 2-60) for all contrasts, to separate what the rule can and cannot change
number of R0_GUARD runs in which the rule fired (expected 144 of 144 unless the plant history differs; the first decision is plant-free)
mean total variation of the command per arm

gates_before_freeze.G1: onset_mil.run_one reproduces bitwise 6 stored R0_GUARD runs (seed 20261002, onset study) and 4 stored R0 runs on R0-reversed pairs of the closed-loop study; on 3 pairs without a reversed R0 first move the R0_GUARD run equals the stored R0 run and the rule does not fire; guard unit test passes
gates_before_freeze.G2: the analysis code reproduces bitwise the stored panel-A per-pair contrasts COISC-R0, L0-R0, COISC-L0 from raw runs; synthetic selftest recovers known effects and verdict logic
gates_before_freeze.smoke: two R0_GUARD runs on the smoke checkpoint outside the study directory; metric path on them

deviations_policy: Technical interruptions are resumed under the same hash with completed runs skipped (runs are deterministic). No run, plant or pair is removed. Any analysis-code change after freeze is a numbered amendment reported in the paper.
reporting: The result enters the manuscript whatever the verdict, labelled as a preregistered post-S4 stage on reused models.
execution_authorization_rule: gd_mil.py execute and gd_analyze.py analyze require EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.json written on the author's explicit instruction, naming this file's SHA-256
